conclusion: HDiv-VIM's main cost risk (the heavy singular-Gram matrix build) is neutralized by the HACApK charge-Gram at engineering scale: the build scales ~N^1.2 and becomes comparable to the moment method's build by ~34k DoF. For small N, MMMM can build faster, but both methods are already fast enough that this is a latency sanity check rather than a Radia backend-selection criterion. Combined with the curved/high-order accuracy and Reduced-FEM coupling wins, these data support the Radia HDiv-only production direction, with MMMM retained in ELF_MAGIC@研究室版 and as a temporary transition cross-check.
